quote.acceptanceMethodRequired: Say how the client accepted the quote.
quote.acceptanceProofInvalid: This proof is not a file uploaded from the back-office: attach the PDF or the image again.
quote.acceptanceProofNotAllowed: A proof can only be attached when the quote is accepted.
quote.acceptedNotRevisable: Quote {{number}} is accepted: it can no longer be revised. Create an amendment for the extra work instead.
quote.alreadyRevised: Quote {{number}} was revised at the same moment by someone else: reload the list.
quote.amendmentNotAllowed: Quote {{number}} is {{status}}: only an accepted quote can be amended.
quote.clientNotActive: This client is archived or anonymized: put it back in the list before writing it a quote.
quote.contactAlreadyConverted: This request has already become quote {{number}}: it cannot become a second one.
quote.contactHasNoEmail: This request has no e-mail address: create the client by hand, then the quote.
quote.contactNotAgency: Only a quote request sent from the Aldaron site can become a quote.
quote.contactNotFound: Request not found, or moved to the recycle bin.
quote.notEditable: A quote that is {{status}} can no longer be edited: only a draft can.
quote.parentClientMismatch: A revision or an amendment is written for the client of quote {{number}}.
quote.parentNotAllowed: Quote {{number}} is {{status}}: no revision or amendment can point to it.
quote.parentNotFound: The quote revised or amended was not found.
quote.revisionNotAllowed: A quote that is {{status}} cannot be revised: only a sent quote can.
quote.statusChangeNotAllowed: A quote that is {{from}} cannot become {{to}}.
